exposure: obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS) in previous delivery
cohort: 26,598 Women with OASIS from Finland, Norway, and Sweden
finding: Women with a history of OASIS had a higher risk of OASIS recurrence, more cesarean deliveries, and fewer subsequent deliveries compared to women without prior OASIS.
mod_finding: Women with a history of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS) had higher rates of cesarean deliveries in subsequent pregnancies compared to women without prior OASIS.
